title: Deauthorizing a trustline removes offers, redeems pool shares into claimable balances and deletes the pool
pattern: SET_TRUST_LINE_FLAGS clears every authorization on mm's XPF trustline. Core removes mm's three XPF offers, redeems mm's pool shares into two claimable balances for mm (no CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE), removes the pool-share trustline and, mm being the last shareholder, the pool itself. Readers that only create balances and pools from their own operations miss all of it.

hazards.placement: revocation creates claimable balances from pool shares and removes offers
trustline fully deauthorized (flags 4: only the clawback bit)
pool entry removed by a revocation

facts.says: Two claimable balances are created, each for mm.
mm's XPF trustline keeps only the clawback bit (flags 4).
